definition: a scene of uproar and confusion
hook: When a room descends into bedlam, you are naming a real address in London.
modernAnchor: The crowd surged, the alarms went off, total bedlam. We use it for any scene of pure chaos.

origin.originalMeaning: the Hospital of St Mary of Bethlehem

journey: In 1247, London founded a priory called the Hospital of St Mary of Bethlehem.
By the 1400s it had become an asylum for the insane - one of Europe's first and worst.
Londoners slurred Bethlehem into Bedlam. The hospital grew so notorious its nickname became a word.
For a fee, the public once paid to watch the patients. That chaos still names our worst rooms.
